rows.text: Pick the kettle from the counter and place it on a stove burner. Then turn the burner on.
Pick the kettle from the counter and place it on the stove.
Pick the kettle from the counter and place it on a stove burner.
Pick the kettle from the counter and place it on the stove. Then turn the burner on.
Pick up the kettle from the counter and place it on the stove burner.
Pick the kettle from the counter.
Pick up the kettle from the counter and place it on a burner of the stove.
Pick the kettle from the counter by the handle and place it on the stove.
Pick the kettle handle firmly from the counter and place it on the stove.
Pick the kettle from the counter again and place it on the right burner of the stove.
